item.title: প্রবীণদের শারীরিক কল্যাণে একাকিত্ব দূর করা জরুরি: সালেহউদ্দিন
item.description: সালেহউদ্দিন আহমেদ মন্তব্য করেছেন যে কেবল আর্থিক সচ্ছলতা বয়স্কদের সুস্বাস্থ্য নিশ্চিত করতে পারে না। সম্পদ থাকা সত্ত্বেও অনেক প্রবীণ মানুষ নিঃসঙ্গতায় ভুগে থাকেন।

item.title: অনিয়ন্ত্রিত বাণিজ্যিকীকরণে বসবাসের উপযুক্ততা হারাচ্ছে ঢাকা
item.description: বুয়েট শিক্ষক শায়ের গফুর উল্লেখ করেন যে অপরিকল্পিতভাবে জমি ব্যবসায়ে ব্যবহারের ফলে ঢাকা শহরের বসবাসযোগ্য পরিবেশ নষ্ট হয়েছে। কর্তৃপক্ষের নিষ্ক্রিয়তার মাঝে এই প্রবণতা রোধ না করলে শহরের মান ফেরানো অসম্ভব।

item.title: মস্তিষ্ক ও কম্পিউটারের সংযোগমাধ্যম হিসেবে কিবোর্ডের ভূমিকা
item.description: কম্পিউটারে তথ্য প্রেরণের ক্ষেত্রে স্পর্শসংবেদনশীল পর্দা বা কণ্ঠস্বরের ব্যবহার থাকলেও, চিন্তাভাবনা কার্যকরভাবে রূপান্তর করতে কিবোর্ডই প্রধান মাধ্যম হিসেবে কাজ করে চলেছে।

item.title: বাংলাদেশ রসায়ন অলিম্পিয়াডের আঞ্চলিক রাউন্ড সম্পন্ন ও চূড়ান্ত তারিখ ঘোষণা
item.description: শনিবার উচ্চ মাধ্যমিক ও এ-লেভেলের শিক্ষার্থীদের নিয়ে এই প্রতিযোগিতা সম্পন্ন হয়। প্রতিযোগিতার প্রতিটি কেন্দ্র থেকে সেরা দশজনকে সনদ ও পদক দেওয়া হয়েছে এবং আগামী ২৮ নভেম্বর চূড়ান্ত পর্ব নির্ধারিত হয়েছে।

item.title: নৌবাহিনীর জাহাজে পানি প্রবেশের ঘটনায় হতাহতের অনুপস্থিতি
item.description: একটি নৌবাহিনীর জলযানে পানি ঢোকার ঘটনা ঘটেছে। তবে এই দুর্ঘটনায় কোনো ধরনের প্রাণহানি বা আহত হওয়ার খবর পাওয়া যায়নি।

item.title: দেশীয় প্রযুক্তিতে নির্মিত বি২৮ বুলেট ট্রেনের সংকোচন পরীক্ষা সম্পন্ন
item.description: স্বদেশী উদ্যোগে তৈরি নতুন বুলেট ট্রেন বি২৮-এর ওপর নির্ধারিত 'স্কুইজ টেস্ট' বা সংকোচন পরীক্ষা সফলভাবে সম্পন্ন করা হয়েছে।

item.title: যুদ্ধবিরতির পর ইউক্রেনে পরিবারের সঙ্গে ওলেশকির বাসিন্দাদের পুনর্মিলন
item.description: শনিবার যুদ্ধবিরতির সুযোগে রুশ নিয়ন্ত্রিত ওলেশকি থেকে ইউক্রেনীয় অংশে পৌঁছানোর পর বাস্তুচ্যুত মানুষেরা তাদের পরিবারের সঙ্গে মিলিত হয়েছেন। স্থানীয় বাসিন্দারা পতাকা উড়িয়ে এই আগমনকে স্বাগত জানান।

item.description: বালেন শাহের প্রথম ভারত সফরকালে নেপাল সরকার দেশটির নিকট থেকে বিভিন্ন খাতে আর্থিক সহযোগিতা ও বিনিয়োগ পাওয়ার প্রস্তাব উত্থাপন করবে।

item.title: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca faces growing squad challenges
item.description: Following an initial run of seven consecutive Premier League victories under Enzo Maresca, Manchester City is now confronting new difficulties as the manager's initial winning streak concludes.

item.title: Worshipers express concern regarding Kandakottam temple festival management
item.description: Attendants at the Kandakottam temple have voiced anxiety concerning the upcoming organization and execution of the traditional Kandasashti festival.

item.title: SRIHER organizes nationwide symposium focused on qualitative nursing studies
item.description: SRIHER has opened its doors to a national-level conference dedicated to qualitative research methodologies within the nursing profession.

item.title: Law enforcement hunts for POCSO suspect fleeing medical facility
item.description: Authorities are actively looking for an individual charged under the POCSO Act who escaped while receiving treatment at a hospital.

item.title: New integrative diabetes facility opens doors in Chennai
item.description: The Ayur AI Integrative Diabetes Centre has officially commenced operations in Chennai, offering specialized care services.

item.title: West Indies Chasing 170 After Bowlers Dismiss Bangladesh in Dhaka
item.description: Bangladesh was bowled out for 142 as Roston Chase claimed five wickets and Jomel Warrican took four. The West Indies now require 170 runs to secure victory in Dhaka.

item.title: Ruling party legislator questioned for hours over statements about Chief Minister
item.description: A DMK legislator underwent more than two hours of questioning regarding controversial comments made against the Chief Minister.

item.title: Profile of emerging Pakistani all-rounder Arafat Minhas
item.description: Young cricket talent Arafat Minhas has quickly established himself as a reliable match-winning player for Pakistan through his composed performances.

item.title: Motorcyclist dies following Kotturpuram vehicle collision
item.description: A young man named Madhan passed away from his wounds at the Government Royapettah Hospital after a car collided with his motorcycle in Kotturpuram.

item.title: Rajasthan IPS Officer Transferred Following ACB Inquiry Into IAS Spouse
item.description: Authorities in Rajasthan have reassigned an IPS officer. This decision follows the launch of an Anti-Corruption Bureau investigation targeting her IAS husband.

item.title: আইনি নোটিশ পেলেন চিত্রনায়ক শরিফুল রাজ
item.description: বারবার সময় চেয়েও তা না পাওয়ার অভিযোগ এনে অভিনেতা শরিফুল রাজের বিরুদ্ধে আইনি নোটিশ পাঠানো হয়েছে। শিডিউলসংক্রান্ত জটিলতার কারণে এই পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া হয়েছে।

item.title: London Police Detain 48 During Protests Against Palestine Action Ban
item.description: Metropolitan police in London took 48 individuals into custody as crowds gathered to protest the prohibition of Palestine Action. Rallies also occurred in Edinburgh ahead of a UK Supreme Court hearing.

item.title: SRM Prime Hospital Illuminates Pink for Breast Cancer Awareness
item.description: SRM Prime hospital has been illuminated in pink tones. The initiative marks the observance of breast cancer awareness month.

item.title: Cab Driver Apprehended for Harassing Elderly Passenger and Dumping Bags
item.description: A taxi operator was taken into custody following an incident involving an elderly female passenger. The driver verbally attacked the woman and discarded her belongings onto the roadway.

item.title: Canine Trapped Near River and Cliff in Nepal Saved After 20 Days
item.description: Rescuers in Nepal successfully saved a dog that remained stuck for nearly three weeks. The animal was cornered between a steep cliff and a fast-flowing river.

item.title: Voters Raise Concerns Over Voter List Deletions at New Delhi Event
item.description: Citizens questioned the removal of names from voter registries during a public event hosted at Mallikarjun Kharge's residence in New Delhi. Student activists and leaders also addressed the gathering.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Cancels 65 Legal Cases Connected to NEET Demonstrations
item.description: The Tamil Nadu administration has issued directives to drop 65 separate cases. These legal proceedings were previously filed against individuals protesting the NEET examinations.

item.title: Bharat Sangeet Utsav Officially Inaugurated
item.description: The opening ceremony of the Bharat Sangeet Utsav has officially taken place. Musicians and music enthusiasts gathered to mark the commencement of the cultural event.

item.title: Chennai Corporation Introduces New Dialysis Units and Vehicle
item.description: GCC has rolled out new dialysis machinery and a dedicated vehicle to support kidney disease prevention and awareness efforts. Additionally, authorities are investigating the possibility of setting up specialized pediatric dialysis units at Valluvarkottam for adolescents aged 10 to 18.

item.title: Sydney Artists Oppose Proposed AI Copyright Changes
item.description: Local creators in Anthony Albanese’s electorate of Grayndler are voicing strong opposition to proposed adjustments in copyright regulations. The backlash creates mounting tension for the prime minister within his typically secure constituency.

item.title: Winners Recognized at Kolu Kondattam Golu Contest
item.description: Outstanding traditional doll arrangements across the city received recognition during the Kolu Kondattam competition. Participants showcased creative and cultural displays for the judging panel.

item.title: Egmore Public Grievance Event Sees Welfare Aid Distribution
item.description: A government minister handed out support provisions during a public grievance resolution gathering held in Egmore. The event aimed to address local community complaints and deliver assistance.

item.title: Two Individuals Arrested With Homemade Firearms and Explosives
item.description: Law enforcement officers have taken two people into custody following the discovery of unauthorized firearms and explosive materials in their possession. An investigation into the suspects is currently underway.

item.title: Quad Nations Condemn Economic Coercion and Pledge AI Funding
item.description: Member countries of the Quad alliance have spoken out against economic coercion practices globally. Furthermore, the coalition pledged an allocation of $85 million to broaden artificial intelligence access.

item.title: Modern Bridge Nears Opening to Replace Historic Sholinghur Crossing
item.description: A newly constructed bridge situated close to Sholinghur is scheduled for opening soon. It will serve as a replacement for the aging infrastructure originally built during the British era.

item.title: Bath Defeats Sale 36-28 Following Cokanasiga Double
item.description: Bath triumphed 36-28 over Sale as Joe Cokanasiga contributed two tries. The win halts a three-match winless skid for Bath across all competitions.

item.title: Chennai Metro Tunnelling Triggers Kolathur Sinkhole
item.description: A sinkhole emerged in Kolathur as a result of ongoing underground boring operations conducted by Chennai Metro Rail.

item.title: Glasner Hints at Adjustments After Brentford Loss
item.description: Following a 2-0 defeat against Brentford, manager Oliver Glasner stated that adjustments are necessary for his squad.

item.title: Tirupattur Police Apprehend Two Over Illegal Foetus Sex Test
item.description: Authorities in Tirupattur have taken two individuals into custody for trying to identify the gender of an unborn child.

item.title: Dasara Light Displays Prolonged Through Sunday for Rajyotsava
item.description: In honor of Rajyotsava, the festive Dasara illumination has been kept active until Sunday.

item.title: Oleshky Evacuees Reach Safe Areas to Reunite With Relatives
item.description: Civilians extracted from the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky have successfully crossed into Ukrainian-held regions to join their families.

item.title: Rubio Clarifies U.S. Had No Direct Role in Flavio Bolsonaro Departure
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro and his family traveled to the United States on October 28 following his October 25 presidential runoff defeat. Rubio stated the U.S. was not directly involved in the flight.

item.title: Delhi Chief Minister Clears 2,345 New Fire Service Positions
item.description: The Chief Minister has sanctioned the creation of 2,345 new job openings within the Delhi Fire Services.

item.title: Attappady hospital to receive specialist care and newborn unit
item.description: Kerala's health minister announced that NABARD will fund a new facility at the Attappady tribal hospital. The expansion will feature newborn care services and an urgent surgical theatre.

item.title: Binance CEO reports recovery of most funds after major crypto theft
item.description: Following a massive digital currency breach where hackers took billions from users, the head of Binance stated that ninety percent of the missing capital has been restored. The platform intends to reimburse the rest.

item.title: ছয় রুটে পুরোনো বাস দিয়ে নতুন পরিবহন সেবা রোববার থেকে
item.description: সংস্কার করা পুরোনো বাস দিয়ে আগামী রোববার থেকে ছয়টি রুটে নতুন পরিবহন কার্যক্রম শুরু হবে। এই সেবা পরিচালনার দায়িত্ব পেয়েছে মোট ছয়টি ভিন্ন কোম্পানি।

item.title: Massive French protests over living costs and schools spark clashes
item.description: Official figures indicate 320,000 demonstrators participated in France's third consecutive weekend of rallies regarding inflation and education conditions. The gatherings involved confrontations and heightened tensions.

item.title: Memorial speech honoring K.V. Thiruvengadam held in Chennai
item.description: The memorial lecture dedicated to K.V. Thiruvengadam took place in the city of Chennai.

item.title: Choosing the right Roku streaming stick for video resolution needs
item.description: Roku currently offers only one media streaming model that lacks support for 4K video playback resolution.

item.title: Jaishankar and Lavrov hold talks in Atlanta on Ukraine and West Asia
item.description: Indian External Affairs Minister Jaishankar met with Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov in Atlanta. The officials conferred on regional conflicts in Ukraine and the Gulf, alongside international affairs.

item.title: Rare 1928 Bentley discovered by explorer inside derelict British barn
item.description: An urban explorer uncovered a rare 1928 Bentley 4.5 Litre Sports Tourer covered in dust within an old British agricultural building. Only 148 units of this historic vehicle with its original coachwork were ever built.

item.title: Senegal begins hosting continent's initial Olympic event
item.description: Senegal has officially commenced the Youth Games, marking the first time an Olympic competition takes place on African soil.

item.title: ফ্রান্স ও জার্মানিতে প্রতিবাদ বিক্ষোভ
item.description: ফ্রান্সের স্বরাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয় বিক্ষোভকারীদের হ্যালোউইন মুখোশ ব্যবহারে জরিমানার হুঁশিয়ারি দিয়েছে। প্যারিস, লিল ও লিঁও শহরে মানুষ রাস্তায় নেমে প্রতিবাদ মিছিল শুরু করেছেন।

item.title: Boxing charity leader misdirects funds tied to athlete
item.description: The head of a boxing non-profit transferred a fifty-thousand-dollar donation connected to Stephen Curry into a personal bank account.

item.title: Adjusting specific settings can resolve AirPods audio drops
item.description: Certain automated functions on Apple AirPods may cause unexpected audio dropouts and unintended device switching, which configuration changes can fix.

item.title: Mass demonstrations in France result in over 290 arrests
item.description: For three consecutive weekends, crowds protested living expenses and school conditions in France, leading to violence and numerous arrests.

item.title: Live broadcast covers Youth Olympic Games opening event
item.description: Viewers can follow live updates and coverage of the Youth Olympics opening ceremony taking place in Dakar, Senegal.

item.title: Clashes emerge following demonstrations in France and Germany
item.description: Masked individuals fought with law enforcement in multiple French cities following large demonstrations, while German police deployed tear gas against crowds.

item.title: Evacuees Reach Ukraine From Occupied City
item.description: People who previously ate weeds in a ruined, Russian-controlled city reached Ukraine on Friday. Their departure followed a temporary truce arranged by US First Lady Melania Trump.

item.title: Delhi High Court rejects NIA appeal and maintains terror suspect bail
item.description: The Delhi High Court dismissed a request from the National Investigation Agency, affirming the release of an accused individual in a Jammu and Kashmir terror plot.

item.title: Judge Bhuyan warns against societal fear of inquiry
item.description: Justice Bhuyan stated that authoritarian rule takes root when the public becomes afraid to ask questions.

item.title: Usyk plans cruiserweight bout against Benavidez
item.description: Oleksandr Usyk intends to drop back down to cruiserweight to face David Benavidez prior to his retirement, according to an advisor.
